# shadcn/ui theme

Generated by `npm run build:tokens` from `tokens/tokens.json`. Change the tokens, not these files.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `registry/lds.json` | Theme item: colors (light and dark), type scale, letter spacing, spacing, elevation, radius, motion curves |
| `registry/lds-font-sans.json`, `registry/lds-font-mono.json` | Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono as `registry:font` items |
| `globals.css` | Complete Tailwind v4 `globals.css` to copy, dark under `.dark` or `data-theme="dark"` |
| `globals.v3.css` + `tailwind.preset.cjs` | The same theme for Tailwind v3 |

Install into a shadcn project:

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add registry/lds.json registry/lds-font-sans.json registry/lds-font-mono.json
```

Mapping, hosting and every utility: `skills/lampung-design-system/references/platforms.md`, section shadcn/ui.
